Actually buying 1 unit at 12 to sell later: future market prices — opponents sell too, counter will advance. Round 4 market: I can't sell. Others may sell? Order rotates... it's my turn now in round 4 market.

Buy moves sale counter backwards, meaning prices go up for future sellers. I'd sell in round 5 after shuttle. Price maybe ~12 for first units. Selling 5 goods at ~12,10,9,8,7 = 46 vs cost 24 plus opportunity... but buying doesn't gain money directly, selling would. Actually cash devalues 62% between rounds: 16.83 devalued to 10.45. Hmm.

Alternative: keep 28.83 cash → 17.88 after deval. Buy 2: 4.83 → 2.99, plus goods worth selling ~45ish in round 5 before deval? Round 5 market I sell. Approximately selling 5 units yields ~50. Total wealth ≈ 50+3 = 53 vs 17.9+ later sales of 3 shuttle goods (~30ish) = 48? Close. Also keeping rank. And license auction in action round 4 — need cash to bid. Buying reduces bid capacity; license income 20-60.

Actually better: keep cash for license bid. License income up to 60 alashi extra — that's huge. Cash 28.83 could outbid rivals (17 and 6.2). Keep cash, pass, then bid ~12-18 in auction.

So choice 0, pass.
